checks.note: The profile ran 7.1s in the maintainer's working copy, where `.sitegen-cache/` already holds every resized image and remote include. The metric is the 64.2s CI build that starts without the cache, so the profile never sees the resizing or the fetches.
The next measurement profiles the CI scenario itself: a build from an empty cache, through the harness.
